warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** EVERY MAJOR PIECE OF SANITARY EQUIPMENT SIZED ON SN-04 IS PRICED HERE, AND THE CAPACITIES MATCH EXACTLY: stainless water tank 1 ลบ.ม., prefabricated septic unit 1 ลบ.ม., grease trap not less than 30 litres. *** SN-04's fuller specifications (brands, the septic unit's four catalogue models, the pump performance) do not appear -- the BOQ prices by capacity alone.

*** THE MANHOLE COUNT IS 11, WHERE THE SN-04 PLAN SHOWS 8. *** The plan count was read off the drawn symbols and flagged count_read_from_symbols; the BOQ's 11 is the authority. Either three symbols were missed at page scale or the estimator allowed extra. The SN-04 flag is confirmed as a real uncertainty and this is the better figure.
48 m of ø0.20 m concrete pipe is the external storm drainage run at 1:400 from SN-04.
One dimension is a clear typo: 'รางระบายน้ำ ค.ส.ล กว้าง 03.0 ม.' -- 0.30 m is meant, as SN-04's callout and SN-10's detail both state. Transcribed as printed and flagged dimension_typo_on_source.

*** THE RC CHANNEL IS ONLY 6.5 M LONG. *** SN-04 draws it along the north and east sides of the house, which is considerably more than 6.5 m of run. Either the plan run is longer than measured or only part of it is priced; flagged for the estimator.

The kitchen waste line (ท่อน้ำทิ้งจากครัว, ø2", 3 m) is priced separately here rather than under 3.2, because it runs to the grease trap rather than to the soil system -- matching SN-01's separate 'K' pipe symbol and SN-04's ø2"K tag.
The BOOSTER PUMP is NOT here -- it is priced under 3.5 with the water pipework. Do not double-count.
